1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, de hojas compuestas por tres hojuelas, fragantes flores azules y fruta ovalada. Lamiaceae Vitex divaricata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 20 m, with compound leaves composed of three leaflets, fragrant blue flowers and oval fruit. Lamiaceae Vitex divaricata.
